name: WorkOS Pipes
description: Manages OAuth connections and auto-refreshed tokens for users' GitHub, Slack, Salesforce and other accounts, so SaaS apps and their agents can act in those apps on users' behalf.

skills.name: Access tokens
skills.description: Returns a user's current provider access token, refreshed automatically, with any missing scopes listed.

skills.name: Relay
skills.description: Calls the provider API on your behalf and returns its response, so the user's token never enters your environment.

skills.name: Connection sharing
skills.description: Lets an organization admin connect a provider once and share it with every active member.

skills.name: Custom providers
skills.description: Defines providers beyond the built-in list, using OAuth, API keys or client credentials.

skills.name: Pipes widget
skills.description: Provides a pre-built UI where users connect and manage their third-party accounts.
